rear_wheel_load_frac_est.note: share of total weight on the 2 driven rear wheels. 0.5 if front has only 2 casters and load is centred; ~0.33 if all 4 original GFS-1830 casters were kept (6 contact points, rigid deck -> statically indeterminate, depends on wheel height vs casters); 0.25 if driven wheels sit slightly high. MEASURE with bathroom scale.

geometry.cog_note: whole loaded cart (all items incl. buffer; fog/power station/Pi/buffer on deck at ~0.25-0.30 m). low/mid/high use matching low/mid/high masses, deck, ball and bear CoM fraction, so 'high' = highest CoG case.
geometry.track_note: GFS-1830 platform 18 in = 0.457 m wide; corner casters inset ~1-1.5 in each side -> ~0.38-0.42 m. Driven wheel track unmeasured.
geometry.wheelbase_note: platform 30 in = 0.762 m; caster centres inset ~2 in each end -> ~0.62-0.70 m. Unmeasured.
geometry.tip_note: static tip angle sideways = atan((track/2)/cog_h); lateral accel to tip = g*(track/2)/cog_h. Bear 43 in wide overhangs 18 in deck.

anker_note: C300, C800 Plus, C1000 all have a 12V/10A car socket (120W). If it is an F-series (F1200/F2000, 20-30 kg) totals rise ~+10-18 kg.
